```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| message: false 
#| warning: false 
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Single Trait-Distribution

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| message: false 
#| warning: false 
ggplot(data = penguins)+
  geom_jitter(mapping=aes(x=bill_length_mm, y=species))




```

## Relationship between multiple traits

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| message: false 
#| warning: false 
ggplot(data = penguins)+
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=body_mass_g, y=flipper_length_mm,color=species))
```

| Column names      |
|-------------------|
| species           |
| island            |
| bill_length_mm    |
| bill_depth_mm     |
| flipper_length_mm |
| body_mass_g       |
| sex               |
| year              |

## Sexual Dimorphism

```{r}
#| echo: false 
#| message: false 
#| warning: false 
ggplot(data = penguins)+
  geom_path(mapping=aes(x=body_mass_g, y=species,color=sex))
```
